build_HyperConv_layer: build a HyperConv layer that generates different convolution weights for each time step from an input variable
build_HyperConvBlock_layer: build a HyperConvBlock layer with residual and skip connections for temporal convolution processing
run_HyperConv_forward: run the HyperConv forward pass on input signal x and weight-generating input z to get hyper-convolution output
run_HyperConvBlock_forward: run the HyperConvBlock forward pass to produce residual output and skip connection output tensors
review_HyperConvBlock_receptive_field: review the HyperConvBlock receptive_field method to compute the effective receptive field size from kernel and dilation
